_about: What every generated insole is checked against before it is sliced (footscan review, docs/ALWAYS-ON.md). Edit when the shoe changes.
target_length_source: size-chart insole length for US men's 9.5, not a ruler measurement of this shoe's insole
tolerances_source: a judgment, not measured: a file that misses the target by more than this was built without the shoe length or scaled; a shoe's outline more than shoe_length_tolerance_mm off its chart length was scanned at the wrong scale or is another size
